pred_sql: SELECT MAX(f."FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" / f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)") FROM california_schools.frpm f WHERE f."COUNTY NAME" = 'Alameda County' AND f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" > 0

SELECT frpm."FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)" / frpm."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" FROM california_schools.frpm frpm JOIN california_schools.schools schools ON frpm.cdscode = schools.cdscode WHERE schools.EdOpsCode = 'CON' AND frpm."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" IS NOT NULL AND frpm."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" > 0 ORDER BY frpm."FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)" / frpm."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" ASC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
SELECT DISTINCT s.zip FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE f."CHARTER SCHOOL (Y/N)" = 1 AND f."COUNTY NAME" = 'Fresno County'
SELECT s.mailstreet FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode ORDER BY f."FRPM COUNT (K-12)" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT s.phone FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Directly funded' AND s.charter = 1 AND s.opendate > TO_DATE('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds WHERE sat.avgscrmath > 400 AND s.virtual = 'F'
SELECT s.school FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores ss ON s.cdscode = ss.cds WHERE ss.numtsttakr > 500 AND s.magnet = 1
SELECT s.phone FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds ORDER BY sat.numge1500 DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT SUM(s.numtsttakr) FROM california_schools.satscores s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cds = f.cdscode WHERE f."FRPM COUNT (K-12)" = ( SELECT MAX(f2."FRPM COUNT (K-12)") FROM california_schools.frpm f2 )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.sname) FROM california_schools.satscores T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.cdscode WHERE T1.avgscrmath > 560 AND T2.fundingtype = 'Directly funded'
SELECT f."FRPM COUNT (AGES 5-17)" FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.satscores s ON f.cdscode = s.cds ORDER BY s.avgscrread DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT t.cdscode FROM california_schools.frpm t WHERE ( t."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" + t."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" ) > 500

SELECT MAX(f."FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)" / f."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)") FROM california_schools.satscores s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cds = f.cdscode WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0 AND f."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" > 0 AND (s.NumGE1500 / s.NumTstTakr) > 0.3

WITH RankedSAT AS ( SELECT cds, (NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr) AS excellence_rate, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr) DESC) AS rnk FROM california_schools.satscores WHERE NumTstTakr IS NOT NULL AND NumTstTakr > 0 ) SELECT s.phone FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN RankedSAT rs ON s.cdscode = rs.cds WHERE rs.rnk <= 3 ORDER BY rs.excellence_rate DESC, s.cdscode
SELECT s.ncesschool FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode ORDER BY f."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s.dname FROM california_schools.satscores s JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT t.district FROM california_schools.schools t WHERE t.statustype = 'Active') active_districts ON s.dname = active_districts.district GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrread) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT COUNT(T1.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.satscores T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cds WHERE T1.county = 'Alameda' AND T1.statustype = 'Merged' AND T2.numtsttakr < 100

SELECT s.school, s.charternum, sat.avgscrwrite FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds WHERE sat.avgscrwrite > 499 AND s.charternum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sat.avgscrwrite DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds WHERE s.county = 'Fresno' AND s.fundingtype = 'Directly funded' AND sat.numtsttakr <= 250
SELECT s.phone FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds ORDER BY sat.avgscrmath DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.cdscode) FROM california_schools.frpm T1 WHERE T1."COUNTY NAME" = 'Amador' AND T1."LOW GRADE" = '9' AND T1."HIGH GRADE" = '12'
SELECT COUNT(T1."SCHOOL NAME") FROM california_schools.frpm T1 WHERE T1."COUNTY NAME" = 'Los Angeles' AND T1."FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" > 500 AND T1."FRPM COUNT (K-12)" < 700
SELECT sname FROM california_schools.satscores WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa' ORDER BY numtsttakr DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s.school, s.street || ', ' || s.city || ', ' || s.state || ' ' || s.zip FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE ABS(f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" - f."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)") > 30

SELECT DISTINCT f."SCHOOL NAME" FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.satscores s ON f.cdscode = s.cds WHERE f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" > 0 AND f."FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" / f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" > 0.1 AND s.numge1500 > 0

WITH RiversideAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(sat.avgscrmath) AS overall_avg_math FROM california_schools.satscores sat WHERE sat.cname = 'Riverside' ) SELECT s.school, s.fundingtype FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds WHERE sat.cname = 'Riverside' AND (SELECT overall_avg_math FROM RiversideAvg) > 400

SELECT s.school, CASE WHEN s.street IS NOT NULL THEN s.street ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN s.street IS NOT NULL AND (s.city IS NOT NULL OR s.state IS NOT NULL OR s.zip IS NOT NULL) THEN ', ' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN s.city IS NOT NULL THEN s.city ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN s.city IS NOT NULL AND (s.state IS NOT NULL OR s.zip IS NOT NULL) THEN ', ' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN s.state IS NOT NULL THEN s.state ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN s.state IS NOT NULL AND s.zip IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN s.zip IS NOT NULL THEN s.zip ELSE '' END AS full_communication_address FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE s.EILName = 'High School' AND s.city = 'Monterey' AND f."FRPM COUNT (AGES 5-17)" > 800

SELECT s.school, sat.avgscrwrite, s.phone FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.opendate) > 1991 OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.closeddate) < 2000

WITH LocallyFundedEnrollment AS ( SELECT s.school, s.DOCType, f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" - f."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" AS enrollment_difference FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE f."CHARTER FUNDING TYPE" = 'Locally funded' ), AverageDifference AS ( SELECT AVG(enrollment_difference) AS avg_enrollment_difference FROM LocallyFundedEnrollment ) SELECT lfe.school, lfe.DOCType FROM LocallyFundedEnrollment lfe, AverageDifference ad WHERE lfe.enrollment_difference > ad.avg_enrollment_difference

SELECT s.opendate FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE s.gsserved = 'K-12' ORDER BY f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT s.city FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY SUM(f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)") FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

WITH RankedSchools AS ( SELECT frpm."SCHOOL NAME", frpm."FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)", frpm."ENROLLMENT (K-12)", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY frpm."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" DESC) AS rn FROM california_schools.frpm frpm WHERE frpm."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" IS NOT NULL AND frpm."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" > 0 ) SELECT rs."SCHOOL NAME", rs."FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" / rs."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" AS eligible_free_rate FROM RankedSchools rs WHERE rs.rn IN (10, 11)

SELECT f."SCHOOL NAME", NVL(f."FRPM COUNT (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)", 0), 0) AS eligible_frpm_rate FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE s.SOC = '66' ORDER BY f."FRPM COUNT (K-12)" DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s.school, s.website FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE f."FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000 AND s.website IS NOT NULL

SELECT f."FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)" / f."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE s.admfname1 = 'Kacey' AND s.admlname1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT s.AdmEmail1 FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE f."CHARTER SCHOOL (Y/N)" = 1 AND f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" = ( SELECT MIN(f2."ENROLLMENT (K-12)") FROM california_schools.frpm f2 WHERE f2."CHARTER SCHOOL (Y/N)" = 1 AND f2."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" IS NOT NULL ) AND s.AdmEmail1 IS NOT NULL

SELECT s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1, s.AdmFName2 || ' ' || s.AdmLName2, s.AdmFName3 || ' ' || s.AdmLName3 FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores ss ON s.cdscode = ss.cds WHERE ss.numge1500 = (SELECT MAX(numge1500) FROM california_schools.satscores)

WITH SchoolExcellence AS ( SELECT s.cds, NVL(s.NumGE1500 / NULLIF(s.NumTstTakr, 0), 0) AS excellence_rate FROM california_schools.satscores s ), RankedSchools AS ( SELECT se.cds, se.excellence_rate, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY se.excellence_rate ASC) as rnk FROM SchoolExcellence se ) SELECT sch.street, sch.city, sch.zip, sch.state FROM california_schools.schools sch JOIN RankedSchools rs ON sch.cdscode = rs.cds WHERE rs.rnk = 1
SELECT s.website FROM california_schools.satscores ss JOIN california_schools.schools s ON ss.cds = s.cdscode WHERE ss.cname = 'Los Angeles' AND ss.numtsttakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000
SELECT AVG(s.numtsttakr) FROM california_schools.schools sch JOIN california_schools.satscores s ON sch.cdscode = s.cds WHERE sch.county = 'Fresno' AND TO_CHAR(sch.opendate, 'YYYY') = '1980'
SELECT s.phone FROM california_schools.satscores ss JOIN california_schools.schools s ON ss.sname = s.school WHERE ss.dname = 'Fresno Unified' ORDER BY ss.avgscrread ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

WITH RankedVirtualSchools AS ( SELECT s.school, s.county, ss.avgscrread, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.county ORDER BY ss.avgscrread DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores ss ON s.cdscode = ss.cds WHERE s.virtual = 'F' ) SELECT rvs.school FROM RankedVirtualSchools rvs WHERE rvs.rnk <= 5
SELECT s.EdOpsName FROM california_schools.satscores sat JOIN california_schools.schools s ON sat.cds = s.cdscode ORDER BY sat.AvgScrMath DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT s.avgscrmath, s.cname FROM california_schools.satscores s ORDER BY s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrread + s.avgscrwrite FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s.avgscrwrite, sch.city FROM california_schools.satscores s JOIN california_schools.schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.numge1500 = (SELECT MAX(numge1500) FROM california_schools.satscores)
SELECT s.school, sat.avgscrwrite FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds WHERE s.admfname1 = 'Ricci' AND s.admlname1 = 'Ulrich'

SELECT s.school, f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE s.doc = '31' ORDER BY f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(s.cdscode) / 12 FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.county = 'Alameda' AND TO_CHAR(s.opendate, 'YYYY') = '1980' AND s.doc = '52'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN s.StatusType = 'Merged' AND s.DOC = '54' AND s.County = 'Orange' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN s.StatusType = 'Merged' AND s.DOC = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM california_schools.schools s

WITH ClosedSchoolCounts AS ( SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS num_closed_schools FROM california_schools.schools WHERE statustype = 'Closed' GROUP BY county ), MaxClosedCounty AS ( SELECT county FROM ClosedSchoolCounts ORDER BY num_closed_schools DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ) SELECT s.county, s.school, s.closeddate FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN MaxClosedCounty mcc ON s.county = mcc.county WHERE s.statustype = 'Closed'

SELECT s.school, s.mailstreet, s.mailcity, s.mailstate, s.mailzip FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN ( SELECT cds, sname, avgscrmath, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avgscrmath DESC) AS math_rank FROM california_schools.satscores WHERE avgscrmath IS NOT NULL ) sat_ranked ON s.cdscode = sat_ranked.cds WHERE sat_ranked.math_rank = 7

SELECT s.mailstreet, s.school FROM california_schools.satscores ss JOIN california_schools.schools s ON ss.cds = s.cdscode WHERE ss.avgscrread = ( SELECT MIN(avgscrread) FROM california_schools.satscores ) FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores ss ON s.cdscode = ss.cds WHERE s.mailcity = 'Lakeport' AND ss.numge1500 > 0
SELECT SUM(T2.numtsttakr) FROM california_schools.schools T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.satscores T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cds WHERE T1.mailcity = 'Fresno'
SELECT s.school, s.mailzip FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.admfname1 = 'Avetik' AND s.admlname1 = 'Atoian'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN s.county = 'COLUSA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.county = 'HUMBOLDT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.mailstate = 'CA'
SELECT COUNT(T1.school) FROM california_schools.schools T1 WHERE T1.mailstate = 'CA' AND T1.statustype = 'Active' AND T1.city = 'San Joaquin'

WITH RankedSchools AS ( SELECT s.cds, s.sname, s.avgscrwrite, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.avgscrwrite DESC) AS rn FROM california_schools.satscores s WHERE s.avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL ) SELECT sch.phone, sch.ext FROM california_schools.schools sch JOIN RankedSchools rs ON sch.cdscode = rs.cds WHERE rs.rn = 333
SELECT school, phone, ext FROM california_schools.schools WHERE zip = '95203-3704'

SELECT DISTINCT s.website FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE ( s.admfname1 = 'Mike' AND s.admlname1 = 'Larson' ) OR ( s.admfname1 = 'Dante' AND s.admlname1 = 'Alvarez' ) OR ( s.admfname2 = 'Mike' AND s.admlname2 = 'Larson' ) OR ( s.admfname2 = 'Dante' AND s.admlname2 = 'Alvarez' ) OR ( s.admfname3 = 'Mike' AND s.admlname3 = 'Larson' ) OR ( s.admfname3 = 'Dante' AND s.admlname3 = 'Alvarez' )
SELECT s.website FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.Virtual = 'P' AND s.charter = 1 AND s.county = 'San Joaquin'
SELECT COUNT(T1.school) FROM california_schools.schools T1 WHERE T1.charter = 1 AND T1.city = 'Hickman' AND T1.doc = '52'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE s.county = 'Los Angeles' AND s.charter = 0 AND f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" > 0 AND ( f."FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" * 100 / f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" ) < 0.18

SELECT s.school, s.city, TRIM(s.admfname1 || ' ' || s.admlname1) AS administrator_name FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.charter = 1 AND s.charternum = '00D2' AND TRIM(s.admfname1 || ' ' || s.admlname1) IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT s.school, s.city, TRIM(s.admfname2 || ' ' || s.admlname2) AS administrator_name FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.charter = 1 AND s.charternum = '00D2' AND TRIM(s.admfname2 || ' ' || s.admlname2) IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT s.school, s.city, TRIM(s.admfname3 || ' ' || s.admlname3) AS administrator_name FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.charter = 1 AND s.charternum = '00D2' AND TRIM(s.admfname3 || ' ' || s.admlname3) IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(T1.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools T1 WHERE T1.mailcity = 'Hickman' AND T1.charternum = '00D4'
SELECT ( SUM(CASE WHEN s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(s.cdscode) ) * 100 FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.county = 'Santa Clara' AND s.charter = 1

SELECT COUNT(T1.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools T1 WHERE T1.opendate BETWEEN TO_DATE('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2005-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T1.fundingtype = 'Directly funded' AND T1.county = 'Stanislaus'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.district) FROM california_schools.schools T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.frpm T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cdscode WHERE T1.city = 'San Francisco' AND T1.statustype = 'Closed' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1.closeddate) = 1989 AND T2."DISTRICT TYPE" = 'Community College District'

SELECT s.county FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.SOC = '11' AND TO_CHAR(s.closeddate, 'YYYY') BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989' GROUP BY s.county ORDER BY COUNT(s.cdscode) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT s.ncesdist FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.soc = '31'
SELECT COUNT(T1.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools T1 WHERE T1.county = 'Alpine' AND T1.EdOpsName = 'Community Day School' AND T1.statustype IN ('Active', 'Closed')
SELECT DISTINCT f."DISTRICT CODE" FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE s.magnet = 0 AND s.city = 'Fresno'

SELECT SUM(f."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)") FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE f."ACADEMIC YEAR" = '2014-2015' AND s.edopscode = 'SSS' AND s.city = 'Fremont'

SELECT T1."FRPM COUNT (AGES 5-17)" FROM california_schools.frpm T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.schools T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cdscode WHERE T2.edopsname = 'Youth Authority School' AND T2.mailstreet = 'PO Box 1040'

SELECT MIN(T1."LOW GRADE") KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY CASE WHEN T1."LOW GRADE" = 'P' THEN -2 -- Preschool WHEN T1."LOW GRADE" = 'K' THEN -1 -- Kindergarten WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(T1."LOW GRADE", '^[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(T1."LOW GRADE") -- Numeric grades (1-12) WHEN T1."LOW GRADE" = 'UG' THEN 13 -- Ungraded WHEN T1."LOW GRADE" = 'ADULT' THEN 14 -- Adult education ELSE 999 -- Assign a high value for any other unexpected string, effectively placing them last END ASC ) AS lowest_grade FROM california_schools.frpm T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.schools T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cdscode WHERE T2.edopscode = 'SPECON' AND T2.ncesdist = '0613360'

SELECT s.EILName, s.school FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE f."NSLP PROVISION STATUS" = 'Breakfast Provision 2' AND f."COUNTY CODE" = '37'

SELECT s.city FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE s.EILCode = 'HS' AND f."NSLP PROVISION STATUS" = 'Provision 2' AND f."LOW GRADE" = '9' AND f."HIGH GRADE" = '12' AND f."COUNTY NAME" = 'Merced'

SELECT s.school, f."PERCENT (%) ELIGIBLE FRPM (AGES 5-17)" FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE s.county = 'Los Angeles' AND s.gsserved = 'K-9'
SELECT s.GSserved FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.city = 'Adelanto' GROUP BY s.GSserved ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s.county, COUNT(s.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara') AND s.virtual = 'F' GROUP BY s.county ORDER BY COUNT(s.cdscode) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT s.SOCType, s.school, s.latitude FROM california_schools.schools s ORDER BY s.latitude DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT s.city, s.gsoffered, s.school FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.state = 'CA' ORDER BY s.latitude ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT gsoffered FROM california_schools.schools ORDER BY ABS(longitude) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

WITH MagnetK8MultipleProvision AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS count_val FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND s.GSserved = 'K-8' AND f."NSLP PROVISION STATUS" = 'Multiple Provision Types' ) SELECT s.city, COUNT(s.cdscode) AS schools_k8_count, (SELECT count_val FROM MagnetK8MultipleProvision) AS total_magnet_k8_multi_provision_schools FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-8' GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY s.city

WITH AllFirstNames AS ( SELECT s.admfname1 AS first_name FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.admfname1 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT s.admfname2 AS first_name FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.admfname2 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT s.admfname3 AS first_name FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.admfname3 IS NOT NULL ), NameCounts AS ( SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS name_occurrence_count FROM AllFirstNames GROUP BY first_name ), RankedNameCounts AS ( SELECT first_name, name_occurrence_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY name_occurrence_count DESC) AS rnk FROM NameCounts ), TopTwoNamesWithDistrictsAndCounts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT rnc.first_name, s.district, rnc.name_occurrence_count -- Include name_occurrence_count here to satisfy Oracle's ORA-01791 error when using DISTINCT with ORDER BY FROM RankedNameCounts rnc JOIN california_schools.schools s ON rnc.first_name = s.admfname1 OR rnc.first_name = s.admfname2 OR rnc.first_name = s.admfname3 WHERE rnc.rnk <= 2 ) SELECT first_name, district FROM TopTwoNamesWithDistrictsAndCounts ORDER BY name_occurrence_count DESC, first_name, district

SELECT f."DISTRICT CODE", f."FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" / f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" * 100 FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE s.admfname1 = 'Alusine'
SELECT s.AdmLName1, s.district, s.county, s.school FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.charternum = '40'

SELECT s.AdmEmail1 FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.county = 'San Bernardino' AND s.city = 'San Bernardino' AND s.district = 'San Bernardino City Unified' AND s.opendate BETWEEN TO_DATE('2009-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2010-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ( s.SOCType = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools' OR s.DOCType = 'Unified School District' ) AND s.AdmEmail1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.AdmEmail1) IS NOT NULL
SELECT s.school, s.AdmEmail1 FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores ss ON s.cdscode = ss.cds ORDER BY ss.numge1500 DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) FROM financial.account a JOIN financial.district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND d.a3 = 'East Bohemia'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) FROM financial.account a JOIN financial.loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id JOIN financial.district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(d.a12) > AVG(d.a13) THEN '1995' WHEN AVG(d.a13) > AVG(d.a12) THEN '1996' ELSE 'EQUAL' END FROM financial.district d
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) FROM financial.district d JOIN financial.client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.a11 > 6000 AND d.a11 < 10000

SELECT r.year, r.name, r."DATE", r.time FROM formula_1.races r JOIN formula_1.qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE q.driverid = ( SELECT d.driverid FROM formula_1.drivers d ORDER BY d.dob DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ) ORDER BY r."DATE" ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.driverid) FROM formula_1.drivers T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.results T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid INNER JOIN formula_1.status T3 ON T2.statusid = T3.statusid WHERE T1.nationality = 'American' AND T3.status = 'Puncture'

SELECT c.name, c.url FROM formula_1.constructors c JOIN formula_1.constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name, c.url ORDER BY SUM(cs.points) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT c.url FROM formula_1.constructors c JOIN ( SELECT cs.constructorid, SUM(cs.wins) AS total_wins FROM formula_1.constructorstandings cs GROUP BY cs.constructorid ORDER BY SUM(cs.wins) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ) top_constructor ON c.constructorid = top_constructor.constructorid

SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM formula_1.drivers d JOIN formula_1.laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN formula_1.races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.name = 'French Grand Prix' AND lt.lap = 3 AND lt.milliseconds = ( SELECT MAX(lt2.milliseconds) FROM formula_1.laptimes lt2 JOIN formula_1.races r2 ON lt2.raceid = r2.raceid WHERE r2.name = 'French Grand Prix' AND lt2.lap = 3 )
SELECT r.name, lt.milliseconds FROM formula_1.races r JOIN formula_1.laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE lt.lap = 1 ORDER BY lt.milliseconds FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT AVG( CASE WHEN INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, ':') > 0 THEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(res.fastestlaptime, 1, INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, ':') - 1)) * 60 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(res.fastestlaptime, INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, ':') + 1)) ELSE TO_NUMBER(res.fastestlaptime) END ) FROM formula_1.results res JOIN formula_1.races ra ON res.raceid = ra.raceid WHERE ra.year = 2006 AND ra.name = 'United States Grand Prix' AND res.rank <= 10 AND res.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, AVG(p.milliseconds) AS avg_pitstop_duration_ms FROM formula_1.drivers d JOIN formula_1.pitstops p ON d.driverid = p.driverid WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname ORDER BY avg_pitstop_duration_ms ASC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
SELECT r.driverid, r.time FROM formula_1.races ra JOIN formula_1.results r ON ra.raceid = r.raceid WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2008 AND r.position = 1

SELECT c.constructorref, c.url FROM formula_1.races r JOIN formula_1.results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN formula_1.constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2009 AND r.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix' AND res.position = 1
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.dob FROM formula_1.drivers d WHERE d.nationality = 'Austrian' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) BETWEEN 1981 AND 1991
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, d.url, d.dob FROM formula_1.drivers d WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) BETWEEN 1971 AND 1985 ORDER BY d.dob DESC
SELECT location, country, lat, lng FROM formula_1.circuits WHERE name = 'Hungaroring'

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM formula_1.races r JOIN formula_1.constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid JOIN formula_1.constructors c ON cr.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY c.name, c.nationality ORDER BY total_points DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT AVG(T1.points) FROM formula_1.results T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.drivers T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid INNER JOIN formula_1.races T3 ON T1.raceid = T3.raceid INNER JOIN formula_1.circuits T4 ON T3.circuitid = T4.circuitid WHERE T2.forename = 'Lewis' AND T2.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T4.name = 'Istanbul Park Circuit'

SELECT AVG(races_per_year.num_races) FROM ( SELECT r.year, COUNT(r.raceid) AS num_races FROM formula_1.races r WHERE r."DATE" >= TO_DATE('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND r."DATE" <= TO_DATE('2010-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY r.year ) races_per_year
SELECT nationality FROM formula_1.drivers GROUP BY nationality ORDER BY COUNT(driverid) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

WITH DriverTotalPoints AS ( SELECT ds.driverid, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points FROM formula_1.driverstandings ds GROUP BY ds.driverid ), RankedDrivers AS ( SELECT dtp.driverid, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY dtp.total_points DESC) AS rnk FROM DriverTotalPoints dtp ) SELECT COUNT(r.resultid) FROM formula_1.results r WHERE r.driverid IN (SELECT driverid FROM RankedDrivers WHERE rnk = 91) AND r.positionorder = 1
SELECT r.name FROM formula_1.races r JOIN formula_1.results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid WHERE res.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL ORDER BY res.fastestlaptime ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT c.location || ', ' || c.country FROM formula_1.races r JOIN formula_1.circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r."DATE" = (SELECT MAX(r2."DATE") FROM formula_1.races r2)

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname FROM formula_1.drivers d JOIN formula_1.qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN formula_1.races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid JOIN formula_1.circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 2008 AND c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(q.q3, 1, INSTR(q.q3, ':') - 1)) * 60 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(q.q3, INSTR(q.q3, ':') + 1)) FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, d.nationality, r.name AS first_race_name FROM formula_1.drivers d JOIN formula_1.results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN formula_1.races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE d.dob = ( SELECT MAX(dob) FROM formula_1.drivers ) ORDER BY r."DATE" ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT MAX(accident_count) FROM ( SELECT T2.driverid, COUNT(T2.resultid) AS accident_count FROM formula_1.races T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.results T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid WHERE T1.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND T2.statusid = 3 GROUP BY T2.driverid )

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, SUM(ds.wins) FROM formula_1.drivers d JOIN formula_1.driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE d.dob = ( SELECT MIN(dob) FROM formula_1.drivers ) GROUP BY d.forename, d.surname
SELECT MAX(duration) FROM formula_1.pitstops
SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM formula_1.laptimes
SELECT MAX(T1.milliseconds) FROM formula_1.pitstops T1 WHERE T1.driverid = 1
SELECT T1.lap FROM formula_1.pitstops T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.races T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid WHERE T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND T2.year = 2011 AND T1.driverid = 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, p.duration FROM formula_1.pitstops p JOIN formula_1.drivers d ON p.driverid = d.driverid JOIN formula_1.races r ON p.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 2011 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' ORDER BY d.forename, d.surname
SELECT MIN(T1.milliseconds) FROM formula_1.laptimes T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.drivers T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid WHERE T2.forename = 'Lewis' AND T2.surname = 'Hamilton'
SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM formula_1.laptimes lt JOIN formula_1.drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT T3.name AS circuit_name, T1.position AS driver_position_on_fastest_lap FROM formula_1.laptimes T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.races T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid INNER JOIN formula_1.circuits T3 ON T2.circuitid = T3.circuitid INNER JOIN formula_1.drivers T4 ON T1.driverid = T4.driverid WHERE T4.forename = 'Lewis' AND T4.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T1.milliseconds = ( SELECT MIN(T5.milliseconds) FROM formula_1.laptimes T5 WHERE T5.raceid = T1.raceid AND T5.driverid = T1.driverid )
SELECT lt.time FROM formula_1.laptimes lt JOIN formula_1.races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.name LIKE '%Austrian Grand Prix%' ORDER BY lt.milliseconds FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

WITH ItalianCircuits AS ( SELECT c.circuitid, c.name circuit_name FROM formula_1.circuits c WHERE c.country = 'Italy' ), CircuitLapTimes AS ( SELECT ic.circuit_name, lt.milliseconds, lt.time lap_time_string, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.circuit_name ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC, lt.time ASC) rn FROM ItalianCircuits ic JOIN formula_1.races r ON ic.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN formula_1.laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid ) SELECT clt.circuit_name, clt.lap_time_string FROM CircuitLapTimes clt WHERE clt.rn = 1

WITH AustrianCircuit AS ( SELECT circuitid FROM formula_1.circuits WHERE name = 'Austrian Grand Prix Circuit' ), FastestLapTime AS ( SELECT MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS min_milliseconds FROM formula_1.laptimes lt JOIN formula_1.races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid JOIN AustrianCircuit ac ON r.circuitid = ac.circuitid ) SELECT DISTINCT r.name FROM formula_1.races r JOIN formula_1.laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN AustrianCircuit ac ON r.circuitid = ac.circuitid JOIN FastestLapTime flt ON lt.milliseconds = flt.min_milliseconds

WITH AustrianGP_Circuits AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.circuitid FROM formula_1.races r WHERE r.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix' ), AllRacesAtAustrianGP_Circuits AS ( SELECT r.raceid, r.circuitid FROM formula_1.races r JOIN AustrianGP_Circuits agpc ON r.circuitid = agpc.circuitid ), FastestLapOverall AS ( SELECT lt.raceid, lt.driverid, lt.milliseconds AS fastest_lap_milliseconds FROM formula_1.laptimes lt JOIN AllRacesAtAustrianGP_Circuits aragc ON lt.raceid = aragc.raceid ORDER BY lt.milliseconds FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) SELECT SUM(ps.milliseconds) FROM formula_1.pitstops ps JOIN FastestLapOverall flo ON ps.raceid = flo.raceid AND ps.driverid = flo.driverid
SELECT c.lat, c.lng FROM formula_1.circuits c JOIN formula_1.races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN formula_1.results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid WHERE res.fastestlaptime = '1:29.488'
SELECT AVG(T1.milliseconds) FROM formula_1.pitstops T1 WHERE T1.driverid = 1

SELECT AVG(T1.milliseconds) FROM formula_1.laptimes T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.races T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid INNER JOIN formula_1.circuits T3 ON T2.circuitid = T3.circuitid WHERE T3.country = 'Italy'
SELECT player_api_id FROM european_football_2.player_attributes WHERE overall_rating = ( SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM european_football_2.player_attributes )
SELECT p.player_name, p.height FROM european_football_2.player p WHERE p.height = ( SELECT MAX(p2.height) FROM european_football_2.player p2 )
SELECT pa.preferred_foot FROM european_football_2.player_attributes pa WHERE pa.potential = ( SELECT MIN(pa2.potential) FROM european_football_2.player_attributes pa2 ) FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_api_id) FROM european_football_2.player_attributes pa WHERE pa.overall_rating >= 60 AND pa.overall_rating < 65 AND pa.defensive_work_rate = 'low'

SELECT p.player_name, p.player_api_id FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.crossing DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

WITH LeagueGoals AS ( SELECT m.league_id, SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS total_goals FROM european_football_2.match m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY m.league_id ) SELECT l.name FROM european_football_2.league l JOIN LeagueGoals lg ON l.id = lg.league_id ORDER BY lg.total_goals DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

WITH HomeTeamLosses AS ( SELECT m.home_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS losses_count FROM european_football_2.match m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal GROUP BY m.home_team_api_id ) SELECT t.team_long_name FROM european_football_2.team t JOIN HomeTeamLosses htl ON t.team_api_id = htl.home_team_api_id ORDER BY htl.losses_count ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.player_name FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id GROUP BY p.player_name ORDER BY MAX(pa.penalties) DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT t.team_long_name FROM european_football_2.match m JOIN european_football_2.league l ON m.league_id = l.id JOIN european_football_2.team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND m.season = '2009/2010' AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal GROUP BY t.team_long_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT t.team_long_name, ta.buildupplayspeed FROM european_football_2.team t JOIN european_football_2.team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id ORDER BY ta.buildupplayspeed DESC FETCH FIRST 4 ROWS ONLY

SELECT l.name FROM european_football_2.match m JOIN european_football_2.league l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY COUNT(m.league_id) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(p.birthday, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) / 12) AS current_age FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97 AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(pa."DATE", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY') BETWEEN '2013' AND '2015'
SELECT l.name, COUNT(m.id) AS total_matches FROM european_football_2.league l JOIN european_football_2.match m ON l.id = m.league_id GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY COUNT(m.id) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT AVG(height) FROM european_football_2.player WHERE birthday >= '1990-01-01 00:00:00' AND birthday < '1996-01-01 00:00:00'

WITH PlayerRatings2010 AS ( SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.overall_rating FROM european_football_2.player_attributes pa WHERE SUBSTR(pa."DATE", 1, 4) = '2010' ), PlayerRatingDiffs AS ( SELECT pr.player_api_id, pr.overall_rating - AVG(pr.overall_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY pr.player_api_id) AS rating_above_avg FROM PlayerRatings2010 pr ) SELECT DISTINCT prd.player_api_id FROM PlayerRatingDiffs prd WHERE prd.rating_above_avg = ( SELECT MAX(rating_above_avg) FROM PlayerRatingDiffs )
SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM european_football_2.team_attributes WHERE buildupplayspeed > 50 AND buildupplayspeed < 60

SELECT DISTINCT T1.team_long_name FROM european_football_2.team T1 JOIN european_football_2.team_attributes T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T2."DATE", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY') = '2012' AND T2.buildupplaypassing > ( SELECT AVG(T3.buildupplaypassing) FROM european_football_2.team_attributes T3 WHERE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T3."DATE", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY') = '2012' )

WITH LatestAttributes AS ( SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.preferred_foot, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id ORDER BY TO_DATE(pa."DATE", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') DESC) as rn FROM european_football_2.player_attributes pa ), FilteredPlayers AS ( SELECT p.player_api_id, la.preferred_foot FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN LatestAttributes la ON p.player_api_id = la.player_api_id WHERE la.rn = 1 AND TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(p.birthday, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY')) BETWEEN 1987 AND 1992 ) SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN fp.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(fp.player_api_id) FROM FilteredPlayers fp

SELECT l.name, SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS total_goals FROM european_football_2.match m JOIN european_football_2.league l ON m.league_id = l.id GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY total_goals ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT AVG(pa.long_shots) FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'

SELECT p.player_name FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.height > 180 GROUP BY p.player_name ORDER BY AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

WITH FilteredTeamAttributes AS ( SELECT ta.team_api_id, ta.chancecreationpassing FROM european_football_2.team_attributes ta WHERE ta.buildupplaydribblingclass = 'Normal' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(ta."DATE", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) = 2014 ), TeamAveragePassing AS ( SELECT fta.team_api_id, AVG(fta.chancecreationpassing) AS avg_team_chancecreationpassing FROM FilteredTeamAttributes fta GROUP BY fta.team_api_id ), OverallAveragePassing AS ( SELECT AVG(fta.chancecreationpassing) AS overall_avg_chancecreationpassing FROM FilteredTeamAttributes fta ) SELECT t.team_long_name, tap.avg_team_chancecreationpassing FROM european_football_2.team t JOIN TeamAveragePassing tap ON t.team_api_id = tap.team_api_id CROSS JOIN OverallAveragePassing oap WHERE tap.avg_team_chancecreationpassing < oap.overall_avg_chancecreationpassing ORDER BY tap.avg_team_chancecreationpassing DESC

SELECT l.name FROM european_football_2.match m JOIN european_football_2.league l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE m.season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY l.name HAVING AVG(m.home_team_goal) > AVG(m.away_team_goal)
SELECT t.team_short_name FROM european_football_2.team t WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers'
SELECT player_name FROM european_football_2.player WHERE SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) = '1970' AND SUBSTR(birthday, 6, 2) = '10'

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro' ORDER BY TO_DATE(pa."DATE", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT ta.buildupplaypositioningclass FROM european_football_2.team t JOIN european_football_2.team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'ADO Den Haag' ORDER BY TO_DATE(ta."DATE", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT pa.heading_accuracy FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Francois Affolter' AND pa."DATE" = '2014-09-18 00:00:00'

SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas' AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(pa."DATE", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY') = '2011'
SELECT COUNT(m.id) FROM european_football_2.match m JOIN european_football_2.league l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'

SELECT pa.preferred_foot FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id ORDER BY TO_DATE(p.birthday, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT p.player_name FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.potential = ( SELECT MAX(potential) FROM european_football_2.player_attributes )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.weight < 130 AND pa.preferred_foot = 'left'
SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name FROM european_football_2.team T JOIN european_football_2.team_attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE TA.chancecreationpassingclass = 'Risky'
SELECT DISTINCT pa.defensive_work_rate FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'David Wilson'

SELECT p.birthday FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.overall_rating = ( SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM european_football_2.player_attributes )
SELECT T1.name FROM european_football_2.league T1 INNER JOIN european_football_2.country T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Netherlands'
SELECT AVG(m.home_team_goal) FROM european_football_2.match m JOIN european_football_2.country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Poland' AND m.season = '2010/2011'

WITH MaxMinHeight AS ( SELECT MAX(p.height) AS max_height_val, MIN(p.height) AS min_height_val FROM european_football_2.player p ), PlayersOfInterest AS ( SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN MaxMinHeight mmh ON p.height = mmh.max_height_val OR p.height = mmh.min_height_val ), PlayerAverageFinishing AS ( SELECT poi.player_name, AVG(pa.finishing) AS average_finishing_rate FROM PlayersOfInterest poi JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON poi.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id GROUP BY poi.player_name ) SELECT paf.player_name FROM PlayerAverageFinishing paf ORDER BY paf.average_finishing_rate DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT T1.player_name FROM european_football_2.player T1 WHERE T1.height > 180
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM european_football_2.player WHERE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(birthday, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY') > '1990'
SELECT COUNT(p.id) FROM european_football_2.player p WHERE ( p.player_name LIKE 'Adam %' OR p.player_name = 'Adam' ) AND p.weight > 170

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.overall_rating > 80 AND SUBSTR(pa."DATE", 1, 4) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010'

SELECT pa.potential FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Doran' ORDER BY pa."DATE" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT p.player_name FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left'
SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name FROM european_football_2.team t JOIN european_football_2.team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.buildupplayspeedclass = 'Fast'

SELECT ta.buildupplaypassingclass FROM european_football_2.team t JOIN european_football_2.team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE t.team_short_name = 'CLB' ORDER BY TO_DATE(ta."DATE", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT DISTINCT T1.team_short_name FROM european_football_2.team T1 JOIN european_football_2.team_attributes T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE T2.buildupplaypassing > 70

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.height > 170 AND TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(pa."DATE", 1, 4)) BETWEEN 2010 AND 2015
SELECT player_name FROM european_football_2.player WHERE height = ( SELECT MIN(height) FROM european_football_2.player )
SELECT T2.name FROM european_football_2.league T1 INNER JOIN european_football_2.country T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id WHERE T1.name = 'Italy Serie A'

SELECT T2.team_short_name FROM european_football_2.team_attributes T1 INNER JOIN european_football_2.team T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE T1.buildupplayspeed = 31 AND T1.buildupplaydribbling = 53 AND T1.buildupplaypassing = 32
SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Doran'

SELECT COUNT(m.id) FROM european_football_2.match m JOIN european_football_2.league l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE l.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga' AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(m."DATE", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY-MM') BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10'
SELECT DISTINCT t.team_short_name FROM european_football_2.team t JOIN european_football_2.match m ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id WHERE m.home_team_goal = 10

SELECT p.sex, LISTAGG(DISTINCT p.id, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY p.sex

WITH PatientMaxTCHO AS ( SELECT l.id, MAX(l."T-CHO") AS max_tcho FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l GROUP BY l.id ) SELECT p.id, pmt.max_tcho FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN PatientMaxTCHO pmt ON p.id = pmt.id ORDER BY p.birthday ASC, pmt.max_tcho DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p WHERE p.sex = 'M' AND p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT l.id FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l WHERE l."T-CHO" >= 250 )
SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.tg > 300

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.tg >= 200 AND ( EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) ) > 50
SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.admission = '-' AND l.cpk < 250

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) BETWEEN 1936 AND 1956 AND p.sex = 'M' AND l.cpk >= 250

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) AS age FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.glu >= 180 AND l."T-CHO" < 250

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.sex, p.birthday FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.wbc <= 3.5 OR l.wbc >= 9.0 ORDER BY p.sex, p.birthday

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.diagnosis, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) AS age FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.rbc < 3.5

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, CASE WHEN p.admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted' WHEN p.admission = '-' THEN 'Not Admitted' ELSE 'Admission Status Unknown' END AS admission_status FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.sex = 'F' AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)) >= 50 AND (l.rbc <= 3.5 OR l.rbc >= 6.0)
SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.sex FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.admission = '-' AND l.hgb < 10

SELECT p.id, p.sex FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.hgb > 10 AND l.hgb < 17 ORDER BY p.birthday ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) AS age FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN ( SELECT l.id FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l WHERE l.hct >= 52 GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(l.id) >= 2 ) high_hct_patients ON p.id = high_hct_patients.id
SELECT AVG(HCT) FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DATE") = 1991 AND HCT < 29

WITH LowPlateletPatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT id FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory WHERE plt < 100 ), HighPlateletPatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT id FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory WHERE plt > 400 ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LowPlateletPatients) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HighPlateletPatients) FROM DUAL

SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l."DATE") = 1984 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l."DATE") - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)) < 50 AND l.plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN p.sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) * 100 FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) > 55 AND l.pt >= 14
SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p."FIRST DATE") > 1992 AND l.pt < 14

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l JOIN thrombosis_prediction.examination e ON l.id = e.id WHERE l.aptt > 45 AND e.thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.sex = 'M' AND l.wbc > 3.5 AND l.wbc < 9.0 AND ( l.fg <= 150 OR l.fg >= 450 )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.birthday > TO_DATE('1980-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ( l.fg < 150 OR l.fg > 450 )
SELECT DISTINCT p.diagnosis FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE TO_NUMBER(l."U-PRO" DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) >= 30

SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN (SELECT id, "U-PRO" FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory WHERE TRIM("U-PRO") IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM("U-PRO"), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') ) l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND TO_NUMBER(TRIM(l."U-PRO")) > 0 AND TO_NUMBER(TRIM(l."U-PRO")) < 30
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory t WHERE t.igg >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory T1 INNER JOIN thrombosis_prediction.examination T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE T1.igg > 900 AND T1.igg < 2000 AND T2.symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.iga > 80 AND l.iga < 500 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p."FIRST DATE") >= 1990

WITH AbnormalIgMPatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT id FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory WHERE igm <= 40 OR igm >= 400 ), DiagnosisCounts AS ( SELECT p.diagnosis, COUNT(p.diagnosis) AS diagnosis_frequency FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN AbnormalIgMPatients a ON p.id = a.id GROUP BY p.diagnosis ) SELECT diagnosis FROM DiagnosisCounts ORDER BY diagnosis_frequency DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5 AND ( EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) ) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.examination T1 JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE T2.ra IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.kct = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.diagnosis FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient T1 INNER JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE T1.birthday > TO_DATE('1985-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T2.ra IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE ( REGEXP_LIKE(l.rf, '^[<>]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') AND TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_REPLACE(l.rf, '[^0-9.]', '')) < 20 ) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) > 60

WITH RF_Processed AS ( SELECT e.id, e.thrombosis, -- Safely convert RF to a number if it's a simple numeric string CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(l.rf), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(l.rf)) ELSE NULL END AS rf_val_simple_numeric, -- Safely convert RF to a number if it starts with '<' CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(l.rf), '^<[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') THEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(l.rf), 2)) ELSE NULL END AS rf_val_less_than_prefix FROM thrombosis_prediction.examination e JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON e.id = l.id ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM RF_Processed WHERE thrombosis = 0 AND ( -- Condition for 'normal RF' (RF < 20) -- Case 1: RF is a simple numeric string (e.g., '15', '25.3'). -- We check if the converted numeric value is less than 20. (rf_val_simple_numeric IS NOT NULL AND rf_val_simple_numeric < 20) OR -- Case 2: RF starts with '<' followed by a numeric string (e.g., '<10', '<20', '<19.9'). -- If RF is '<X', it means the actual value is less than X. -- For the condition 'actual_value < 20' to be true, the threshold X itself must be less than or equal to 20. -- For example, if RF is '<15', it's definitely < 20. If RF is '<20', it's definitely < 20. -- If RF is '<20.5', the actual value could be 20.1, which is not < 20, so this case is excluded. (rf_val_less_than_prefix IS NOT NULL AND rf_val_less_than_prefix <= 20) )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.examination e JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON e.id = l.id WHERE e."ANA PATTERN" = 'P' AND l.c3 > 35

SELECT p.id FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0') ORDER BY p."FIRST DATE" FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory T1 INNER JOIN thrombosis_prediction.examination T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE T1.ssb IN ('negative', '0') AND T2.symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient T1 INNER JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE T2.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.SSB IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.sex = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.DNA < 8 AND p.description IS NULL

SELECT ( CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN p.id END) AS NUMBER) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) ) * 100 FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.got >= 60
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.sex = 'M' AND l.got < 60
SELECT MAX(p.birthday) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.got >= 60

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.gpt < 60 AND p.sex = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.admission = '-' AND l.alp < 300

WITH EventQualifyingIncomes AS ( SELECT e.event_id, e.location, COUNT(DISTINCT i.income_id) AS qualifying_income_count FROM student_club.income i JOIN student_club.member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN student_club.attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN student_club.event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE i.amount > 40 -- Based on the hint: "more than fifty incomes refers to income > 40" (assuming 'fifty' is a typo for 'forty' and it clarifies the condition for an individual income to be counted) GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.income_id) > 40 -- Events with more than forty such incomes ) SELECT DISTINCT zc.city, zc.county AS country -- Assuming 'country' refers to 'county' from the zip_code table, as no explicit 'country' column exists FROM EventQualifyingIncomes eqi JOIN student_club.zip_code zc ON TO_NUMBER(eqi.location) = zc.zip_code; -- Assuming event.location stores a zip code

WITH MemberEventCounts AS ( SELECT e.link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT b.link_to_event) AS distinct_event_count FROM student_club.expense e JOIN student_club.budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY e.link_to_member HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.link_to_event) > 1 ), MemberTotalExpenses AS ( SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total_amount_paid FROM student_club.expense e JOIN student_club.member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE e.link_to_member IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM MemberEventCounts) GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name ) SELECT first_name, last_name FROM MemberTotalExpenses ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) FROM student_club.member m JOIN student_club.expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member JOIN student_club.budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id JOIN student_club.event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id WHERE m.position != 'Member'

WITH EventParkingCosts AS ( SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, SUM(ex.cost) AS total_parking_cost FROM student_club.event e JOIN student_club.budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event JOIN student_club.expense ex ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget WHERE b.category = 'Parking' GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name ), AverageParkingCost AS ( SELECT AVG(total_parking_cost) AS avg_cost FROM EventParkingCosts ) SELECT epc.event_name FROM EventParkingCosts epc, AverageParkingCost apc WHERE epc.total_parking_cost < apc.avg_cost

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(T1.cost) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN T3.type = 'Meeting' THEN T1.cost ELSE 0 END) / SUM(T1.cost)) * 100 END FROM student_club.expense T1 JOIN student_club.budget T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id JOIN student_club.event T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id

SELECT b.budget_id FROM student_club.expense e JOIN student_club.budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id WHERE e.expense_description = 'Water, chips, cookies' ORDER BY e.cost DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name FROM student_club.member m JOIN student_club.expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name ORDER BY SUM(e.cost) DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name, m.phone AS contact_number FROM student_club.member m JOIN student_club.expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member WHERE e.cost > ( SELECT AVG(cost) FROM student_club.expense ) GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone

SELECT ( (SUM(CASE WHEN z.state = 'New Jersey' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN z.state = 'Vermont' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 ) / NULLIF(COUNT(m.member_id), 0) FROM student_club.member m JOIN student_club.zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
SELECT T2.major_name, T2.department FROM student_club.member T1 INNER JOIN student_club.major T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T1.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone FROM student_club.member m JOIN student_club.major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id WHERE ma.major_name = 'Elementary Education'
SELECT T1.category, T1.amount FROM student_club.budget T1 INNER JOIN student_club.event T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T2.event_name = 'January Speaker'
SELECT T1.event_name FROM student_club.event T1 INNER JOIN student_club.budget T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T2.category = 'Food'

SELECT T2.category FROM student_club.expense T1 INNER JOIN student_club.budget T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id WHERE T1.expense_description = 'Posters'
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, j.college FROM student_club.member m JOIN student_club.major j ON m.link_to_major = j.major_id WHERE m.position = 'Secretary'
SELECT e.event_name, b.spent FROM student_club.budget b JOIN student_club.event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
SELECT T2.city FROM student_club.member T1 INNER JOIN student_club.zip_code T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code WHERE T1.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T1.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT g.gasstationid) FROM debit_card_specializing.gasstations g JOIN debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t ON g.gasstationid = t.gasstationid JOIN debit_card_specializing.products p ON t.productid = p.productid WHERE g.country = 'CZE' AND p.description = 'Premium gas'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM debit_card_specializing.customers c

SELECT AVG(ym.consumption) / 12 FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE c.segment = 'SME' AND SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) = '2013'

SELECT c.customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.customers c JOIN debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t ON c.customerid = t.customerid JOIN debit_card_specializing.products p ON t.productid = p.productid WHERE c.currency = 'CZK' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t."DATE") = 2011 AND p.description = 'Gas' GROUP BY c.customerid ORDER BY SUM(t.amount * t.price) DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.customerid) FROM debit_card_specializing.customers T1 INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.yearmonth T2 ON T1.customerid = T2.customerid WHERE T1.segment = 'KAM' AND T2.consumption < 30000 AND SUBSTR(T2."DATE", 1, 4) = '2012'

WITH ConsumptionByCurrency AS ( SELECT c.currency, SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) = '2012' AND c.currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR') GROUP BY c.currency ) SELECT ( SELECT total_consumption FROM ConsumptionByCurrency WHERE currency = 'CZK' ) - ( SELECT total_consumption FROM ConsumptionByCurrency WHERE currency = 'EUR' ) FROM DUAL

WITH GasTransactions AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t."DATE") AS transaction_year, t.amount * t.price AS total_gas_cost FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON t.customerid = c.customerid JOIN debit_card_specializing.products p ON t.productid = p.productid WHERE c.currency = 'EUR' AND p.description LIKE '%Gas%' ) SELECT transaction_year FROM GasTransactions GROUP BY transaction_year ORDER BY SUM(total_gas_cost) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT c.segment FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY SUM(ym.consumption) FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) AS year FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE c.currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) ORDER BY SUM(ym.consumption) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

WITH sme_consumption AS ( SELECT SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 5, 2) AS month_num, SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE c.segment = 'SME' AND SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) = '2013' GROUP BY SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 5, 2) ) SELECT month_num FROM sme_consumption ORDER BY total_consumption DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

WITH czk_2013_consumption AS ( SELECT ym.customerid, c.segment, ym.consumption FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE c.currency = 'CZK' AND SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) = '2013' ), customer_total_consumption AS ( SELECT customerid, segment, SUM(consumption) AS total_consumption FROM czk_2013_consumption GROUP BY customerid, segment ), min_consumption_per_segment AS ( SELECT segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_segment_consumption FROM customer_total_consumption WHERE segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') GROUP BY segment ), least_consumption_customers AS ( SELECT ctc.customerid, ctc.segment, ctc.total_consumption FROM customer_total_consumption ctc JOIN min_consumption_per_segment mcps ON ctc.segment = mcps.segment WHERE ctc.total_consumption = mcps.min_segment_consumption ), segment_averages AS ( SELECT segment, SUM(total_consumption) / COUNT(DISTINCT customerid) AS annual_average FROM least_consumption_customers GROUP BY segment ) SELECT (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_averages WHERE segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_averages WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS sme_lam_diff, (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_averages WHERE segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_averages WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS lam_kam_diff, (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_averages WHERE segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_averages WHERE segment = 'SME') AS kam_sme_diff FROM dual

WITH SegmentYearlyConsumption AS ( -- Calculate total consumption for each segment and year (2012, 2013) in EUR SELECT c.segment, SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) AS year, SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013') -- Filter for years 2012 and 2013 AND c.currency = 'EUR' -- Filter for consumption paid in EUR AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') -- Filter for the specified segments GROUP BY c.segment, SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) ), SegmentPivotedConsumption AS ( -- Pivot the data to get 2012 and 2013 consumption for each segment in separate columns SELECT segment, SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012, SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013 FROM SegmentYearlyConsumption GROUP BY segment ), SegmentPercentageIncrease AS ( -- Calculate the percentage increase based on the hint's formula -- Percentage of Increase = (Increase or Decrease / consumption for 2013) * 100% -- Use NULLIF to prevent division by zero if consumption_2013 is 0 SELECT segment, consumption_2012, consumption_2013, ROUND( ((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / NULLIF(consumption_2013, 0)) * 100, 2 ) AS percentage_increase FROM SegmentPivotedConsumption ) -- Select the segment with the biggest percentage increase ( SELECT segment, percentage_increase, 'Biggest Increase' AS type FROM SegmentPercentageIncrease ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC NULLS LAST -- NULLs (if consumption_2013 was 0) are treated as last FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) UNION ALL -- Select the segment with the lowest percentage increase ( SELECT segment, percentage_increase, 'Lowest Increase' AS type FROM SegmentPercentageIncrease ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC NULLS FIRST -- NULLs (if consumption_2013 was 0) are treated as first FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY )
SELECT SUM(ym.consumption) FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym WHERE ym.customerid = 6 AND ym."DATE" BETWEEN '201308' AND '201311'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM debit_card_specializing.customers c WHERE c.segment = 'SME'

SELECT ym.customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE ym."DATE" = '201310' AND c.segment = 'LAM' AND c.currency = 'EUR' ORDER BY ym.consumption DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT c.customerid, SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption FROM debit_card_specializing.customers c JOIN debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym ON c.customerid = ym.customerid WHERE c.segment = 'KAM' GROUP BY c.customerid ORDER BY total_consumption DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT SUM(ym.consumption) FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE c.segment = 'KAM' AND ym."DATE" = '201305'

WITH lam_customers AS ( SELECT c.customerid, ym.consumption FROM debit_card_specializing.customers c JOIN debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym ON c.customerid = ym.customerid WHERE c.segment = 'LAM' ), total_lam_customers AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customerid) AS total_count FROM lam_customers ), lam_customers_above_threshold AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customerid) AS above_threshold_count FROM lam_customers WHERE consumption > 46.73 ) SELECT ( lacat.above_threshold_count / tlc.total_count ) * 100 FROM lam_customers_above_threshold lacat, total_lam_customers tlc

WITH StationAvgPrices AS ( SELECT t.gasstationid, AVG(t.price) AS avg_station_price FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t GROUP BY t.gasstationid ), GlobalAvgPrice AS ( SELECT AVG(t.price) AS global_avg_price FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t ) SELECT gs.country, COUNT(sap.gasstationid) AS value_for_money_gas_stations_count FROM StationAvgPrices sap JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations gs ON sap.gasstationid = gs.gasstationid CROSS JOIN GlobalAvgPrice gap WHERE sap.avg_station_price < gap.global_avg_price GROUP BY gs.country ORDER BY value_for_money_gas_stations_count DESC
SELECT ( SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'Euro' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(c.customerid) ) * 100 FROM debit_card_specializing.customers c WHERE c.segment = 'KAM'

WITH CustomersInFeb2012 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT y.customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth y WHERE SUBSTR(y."DATE", 1, 6) = '201202' ), HighConsumptionCustomersInFeb2012 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT y.customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth y WHERE SUBSTR(y."DATE", 1, 6) = '201202' AND y.consumption > 528.3 ) SELECT ( COUNT(h.customerid) * 100.0 / COUNT(c.customerid) ) FROM CustomersInFeb2012 c LEFT JOIN HighConsumptionCustomersInFeb2012 h ON c.customerid = h.customerid

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(g.gasstationid) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE (COUNT(CASE WHEN g.segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(g.gasstationid) END FROM debit_card_specializing.gasstations g WHERE g.country = 'Slovakia'
SELECT t.customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth t WHERE t."DATE" = '201309' ORDER BY t.consumption DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT ym.customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE ym."DATE" = '201206' AND c.segment = 'SME' ORDER BY ym.consumption ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT MAX(consumption) FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth WHERE SUBSTR("DATE", 1, 4) = '2012'

SELECT DISTINCT gs.country FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations gs ON t.gasstationid = gs.gasstationid WHERE TO_CHAR(t."DATE", 'YYYYMM') = '201306'

SELECT DISTINCT p.description FROM debit_card_specializing.gasstations gs JOIN debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t ON gs.gasstationid = t.gasstationid JOIN debit_card_specializing.products p ON t.productid = p.productid WHERE gs.country = 'CZE'
SELECT DISTINCT t.time FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations g ON t.gasstationid = g.gasstationid WHERE g.chainid = 11

SELECT COUNT(t.transactionid) FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations g ON t.gasstationid = g.gasstationid WHERE g.country = 'CZE' AND t."DATE" > TO_DATE('2012-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
SELECT AVG(t.amount * t.price) FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations g ON t.gasstationid = g.gasstationid WHERE g.country = 'CZE'

SELECT gs.country FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations gs ON t.gasstationid = gs.gasstationid WHERE t."DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-25', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY t.time FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT c.segment FROM debit_card_specializing.customers c WHERE c.customerid = ( SELECT t.customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t ORDER BY t."DATE" ASC, -- "DATE" is a reserved word in Oracle, so it must be quoted. t.time ASC, -- Consider the 'time' column to find the absolute earliest transaction. t.customerid ASC -- Add customerid as a tie-breaker for deterministic results if multiple transactions occur at the exact same date and time. FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY )

WITH TargetCustomer AS ( SELECT DISTINCT customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k WHERE "DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-24', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND amount * price = 124.05 ), MonthlySummary AS ( SELECT 'Total Spending in Jan 2012' AS description, ym."DATE" AS event_date, -- This is 'YYYY-MM' from yearmonth table ym.consumption AS amount_spent FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN TargetCustomer tc ON ym.customerid = tc.customerid WHERE ym."DATE" = '2012-01' ), IndividualTransactions AS ( SELECT 'Transaction on ' || TO_CHAR(t."DATE", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS description, TO_CHAR(t."DATE", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS event_date, -- Convert DATE type to 'YYYY-MM-DD' string t.amount * t.price AS amount_spent FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN TargetCustomer tc ON t.customerid = tc.customerid WHERE t."DATE" >= TO_DATE('2012-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t."DATE" < TO_DATE('2012-02-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) SELECT * FROM MonthlySummary UNION ALL SELECT * FROM IndividualTransactions ORDER BY event_date, description

SELECT DISTINCT t.country FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k tr JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations t ON tr.gasstationid = t.gasstationid WHERE tr.cardid = 667467

SELECT g.country FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations g ON t.gasstationid = g.gasstationid WHERE t.amount = 548.4 AND t."DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-24', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

WITH CustomersOnDate AS ( SELECT DISTINCT t.customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t WHERE t."DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-25', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ), CustomerCurrency AS ( SELECT c.customerid, c.currency FROM CustomersOnDate cod JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON cod.customerid = c.customerid ) SELECT ( COUNT(CASE WHEN cc.currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(cc.customerid) ) * 100 FROM CustomerCurrency cc

WITH TargetCustomer AS ( SELECT DISTINCT t.customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t WHERE t."DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-25', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t.amount * t.price = 634.8 ), CustomerConsumption AS ( SELECT tc.customerid, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013 FROM TargetCustomer tc JOIN debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym ON tc.customerid = ym.customerid WHERE SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013') GROUP BY tc.customerid ) SELECT (cc.consumption_2012 - cc.consumption_2013) / NULLIF(cc.consumption_2012, 0) FROM CustomerConsumption cc

SELECT g.gasstationid FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations g ON t.gasstationid = g.gasstationid GROUP BY g.gasstationid ORDER BY SUM(t.amount * t.price) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

WITH SVK_Customer_Segments AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.customerid, c.segment AS customer_segment FROM debit_card_specializing.customers c JOIN debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t ON c.customerid = t.customerid JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations g ON t.gasstationid = g.gasstationid WHERE g.country = 'SVK' ) SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN scs.customer_segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(scs.customerid) FROM SVK_Customer_Segments scs

SELECT (SELECT SUM(t.amount * t.price) FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t WHERE t.customerid = 38508) AS total_spent_by_customer, (SELECT SUM(t.amount * t.price) FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t WHERE t.customerid = 38508 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t."DATE") = 2012 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t."DATE") = 1) AS spent_in_jan_2012 FROM dual

SELECT p.description FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.products p ON t.productid = p.productid GROUP BY p.description ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

WITH CustomerSpending AS ( SELECT c.customerid, c.currency, SUM(t.amount * t.price) AS total_spending, SUM(t.price) AS sum_of_prices, SUM(t.amount) AS sum_of_amounts FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON t.customerid = c.customerid GROUP BY c.customerid, c.currency ), RankedCustomers AS ( SELECT customerid, currency, total_spending, sum_of_prices, sum_of_amounts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_spending DESC) AS rnk FROM CustomerSpending ) SELECT rc.customerid, rc.total_spending, CASE WHEN rc.sum_of_amounts = 0 THEN 0 ELSE rc.sum_of_prices / rc.sum_of_amounts END AS average_price_per_single_item, rc.currency FROM RankedCustomers rc WHERE rc.rnk = 1

SELECT g.country FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations g ON t.gasstationid = g.gasstationid WHERE t.productid = 2 ORDER BY t.price DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT ym.consumption FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT t.customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t WHERE t.productid = 5 AND t.amount > 0 -- Ensure no division by zero AND t.price / t.amount > 29.00 ) filtered_customers ON ym.customerid = filtered_customers.customerid WHERE ym."DATE" = '201208'
